[[The Skinflayer]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Gorlos Skinflayer]], a [[boss]] who can be found in the [[Heart of the Shiverpeaks]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Smiting Prayers]])
:[[Smiting Prayers]] +1 (20% chance while using [[skill]]s)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Hallowed Idol]], [[dye]]d white (although only the [[PvP Hallowed Idol]] can be dyed).

==Replica==
It is possible to create an exact replica (with exception of color) for this item with:
*[[Hallowed Idol]] from collectors [[Yohei]] or [[Jefri Whylir]] or crafter [[Sheco]]
OR
*Hallowed Idol from collector [[Danira]]
*[[Perfect]] "[[Master of My Domain]]" inscription
OR
*Hallowed Idol from crafters [[Asa]], [[Derrick]], [[Hadusi]], [[Shausha]], [[Soros]], or [[Tehshan]]
*Perfect [[Focus Core]] [[of Fortitude]]
*Perfect "Master of My Domain" inscription

**[[Destroyer Focus]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]]
